versions.changelog:
v1.2.3 is a major documentation update for international users.

- Full documentation translated to English for worldwide ClawHub access  
- Retains all portability, security, and packaging improvements from 1.2.2  
- No functional or API changes; all scripts and usage remain unchanged

m365-planner-v2 1.2.2 introduces improved portability and security.

- Env file path now uses `os.homedir()` for better compatibility across environments.
- Complete check to ensure no sensitive data (IDs, names, domains) remains in the codebase.
- Packaging adjustments: tarball is created; node_modules are excluded to streamline distribution.

m365-planner-v2 v1.2.1 makes all scripts fully generic and removes project-specific data.

- Removed all hardcoded Group IDs and plan names—scripts now require these as parameters.
- Improved "list plans" script: now lists all groups if no ID is provided.
- Cleanup functionality is now flexible and works for any plan or bucket.
- All scripts are ready for generic use, including in ClawHub setups.
- Documentation updated to reflect these changes and provide clearer setup instructions.
